description: Mutation golden fixture (docs/07 §2 Genome/Brain mutation, tasks E03/E04). Pins the exact result of mutating the founder genome through a 50-generation lineage with a fixed PRNG seed, plus the PRNG draw count of a single birth. Any change to the draw order, the roll-interval partition, the sigma scaling or the clamp moves these values and is an ENGINE_VERSION event. Engine 0.5.0 and 0.6.0 both touched none of those: Milestone 8's species analysis draws nothing from the PRNG and never mutates a genome, so the gene block, the brain digest and the PRNG state below are byte-identical to 0.4.0, and only the version stamps moved.
